path_reconstruction_key.mismatch: the declared path names a directory absent from the operator's machine, so the helper falls through to the github source; catalog identity reconstructs the live checkout of the same repository instead
path_reconstruction_key.no_local_source: the declaration's order omits local, so it never resolved from a sibling path
path_reconstruction_key.reconstructed: the declared sibling path equals the provider project path joined to the conventional checkout of its repository
path_reconstruction_key.reconstructed_with_operator_binding: equal once the operator's machine-local binding names that repository's checkout, which lies outside the conventional root

scope_corrections.reason: the five are declared in apps/stack_coder/build_support and the repository root config declares none; the root mix.exs reads the whole table, so repository scope gave stack_coder.stack_coder_workspace five dependencies its own source file does not declare

release_chain.detail: every cross-repository edge is derived from the dependency declarations; the two intra-repository edges inside execution_plane are declared, because a repository-scoped dependency table does not attribute an entry to a project. The full-train order differs from the helper's only in where the two independent packages gemini_ex and inference fall, which no edge constrains.

resolved_disagreements.detail: the repository config requires ~> 0.2.0 and core/replay_engine requires ~> 0.1.0
resolved_disagreements.resolution: both kept: the repository table carries ~> 0.2.0 and the replay-engine project carries its own entry with ~> 0.1.0, so each emits the tuple it emitted before

resolved_disagreements.detail: some consumers name agentjido/jido_integration and others nshkrdotcom/jido_integration; both remotes exist
resolved_disagreements.resolution: the github coordinate is a per-consumer fact and is migrated verbatim; local resolution is identical for every consumer because all of them derive it from the catalogued nshkrdotcom/jido_integration provider, which is the origin of the operator's checkout

resolved_disagreements.detail: stack_lab and jido_integration declared a sibling directory that does not exist; trinity_framework and self_hosted_inference_core declared the one that does
resolved_disagreements.resolution: paths leave the catalog entirely; every consumer now derives local resolution from the catalogued North-Shore-AI repository, which is where the checkout actually is

resolved_disagreements.detail: each application is provided both by a standalone repository and by a vendored copy inside priv_projs
resolved_disagreements.resolution: jido_hive names the standalone project as its provider, matching the origin of the checkout its declared path resolved to

resolved_disagreements.detail: soul_eq/atrillion_intent (helper version 5) omits the antigravity_cli_sdk and amp_sdk edges; stack_coder/apps/stack_coder (helper version 1) carries no release DAG at all
resolved_disagreements.resolution: the twelve-key DAG carried by the other helper variants is canonical; the two omissions are staleness in stale copies, not disagreement, and the migrated catalog reproduces the twelve-key DAG exactly
